subject.title: feat: add Tenki Cloud sandbox backend plugin

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Tenki Cloud as an official externally distributed sandbox plugin, or should this provider integration remain an independently published ClawHub/plugin package?
rationale: The sandbox SDK already supplies the registration seam, but accepting a third-party cloud execution provider determines the supported distribution, dependency-approval, data-boundary, and operational-owner contract; that choice cannot be inferred from the code.

options.title: Route it as an external provider plugin
options.body: Recommended: require a provider-owned package with a supported install route, explicit release ownership, approved dependency graph, and redacted exact-head live proof before it is reconsidered.

options.title: Sponsor official distribution
options.body: Accept it as an official package only after assigning an owning team for dependency updates, tenant-security expectations, support, and release publication.

options.title: Decline the provider integration
options.body: Keep the current OpenClaw sandbox backends and invite Tenki to publish an independent integration through the existing plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Route it as an external provider plugin
recommendation.body: Recommended: require a provider-owned package with a supported install route, explicit release ownership, approved dependency graph, and redacted exact-head live proof before it is reconsidered.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged MXC work is the closest evidence-backed example of the external sandbox-plugin packaging and distribution boundary at issue.
